title: trycua/cua: open infrastructure for computer-using agents
friendlyTitle: Cua gives AI agents safe computers to practise and work on
summary: Cua provides open drivers, virtualised computer environments, cross-platform fleets and benchmarks for training and evaluating agents that operate graphical interfaces. The MIT-licensed project led today’s eligible AI repositories on GitHub Trending with 609 stars added during the day.
friendlySummary: Cua includes tools and test environments for AI agents that click, type and use desktop apps. It gained 609 stars on GitHub today.
whyItMatters: Teams can use it to give agents isolated desktops, automate macOS, Linux or Windows tasks and run repeatable computer-use evaluations. Start in a disposable environment and grant only the files, accounts and network access needed for the test.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can use it to test computer-controlling agents across different operating systems. Begin with an isolated machine and give the agent very limited access.
